status_history.reason: First structured draft from CASE-001 production evidence. Visual system, scene grammar, motion grammar, and compositing boundaries extracted from real AI-writing B-roll project. No current HyperFrames rendering verification has been performed.

title: Greenroom Writing
summary: A studio-extended editing room and evidence wall system using physical object metaphors, paper trails, and warm-cool spatial contrast to translate abstract writing and methodology judgments into concrete visual narratives.
best_for: abstract judgment made tangible through physical objects
content that benefits from life-texture and workshop atmosphere
avoid_for: pure API documentation and code-terminal content
gaming, cyberpunk, or futuristic sci-fi themes
light transparent overlay-only UI without a fullscreen background
content requiring cold institutional or deep-sea data center aesthetics

canvas.tone: near-black green-toned studio with warm lamp pools and a cool evidence wall
canvas.background_policy: One quiet near-black green field anchors the frame; warm lamp zones create depth pockets for physical objects and paper surfaces. The evidence wall occupies a distinct rear plane with string connections.

palette.strategy: Cool green-white text and metallic gray quotes over a near-black green canvas, punctuated by warm lamp amber and restrained green accent glow. No brand hex values are copied.

roles.semantic: quiet studio darkness with green undertone
roles.value_policy: near-black with subtle green warmth, lowest contrast in frame

roles.semantic: main written conclusion or anchor phrase
roles.value_policy: cold white with faint green tint, highest legibility contrast

roles.semantic: evidence highlight, active connection, or current focus
roles.value_policy: one restrained green glow at a time, no more than two simultaneous accent points

roles.semantic: physical object illumination and human-scale warmth
roles.value_policy: amber lamp wash localized to the object plane, never bleeding into the evidence wall

roles.semantic: definitive statement, gold sentence, or takeaway
roles.value_policy: metallic gray with subtle warm undertone, reserved for one key phrase per shot

roles.purpose: carry the single definitive takeaway or gold sentence
roles.style_relation: largest weight and size, metallic toned, Chinese preferred for key statements

roles.purpose: label evidence pieces, steps, or supporting annotations
roles.style_relation: smaller cold white, clean geometric sans-serif, subordinate to the physical object

roles.purpose: mark connections, sources, or timeline references on the evidence wall
roles.style_relation: smallest weight, mono or condensed, faint green tint

typography.local_fallback_policy: Detect available sans-serif and mono fonts locally; verify glyph coverage for Chinese and Latin mixed content before render.

materials: matte near-black canvas with green undertone
string or red line connecting evidence pieces
glass or translucent card for overlay annotations
spatial_hierarchy: paper evidence or written conclusion as secondary anchor
string or line connection as spatial logic
ambient studio depth as tertiary atmosphere
visual_system.whitespace_policy: Reserve breathing room around the physical object; let the evidence wall recede into darker depth. Never crowd the object with text.

focus_policy.rule: One physical object or paper surface owns the shot; all text, string, and glow serve it. Never place two competing hero objects in the same frame.

purposes: translate an abstract concept into a concrete physical object and action
make methodology tangible through everyday items
scene_grammar.composition: Place one physical object center-frame under warm lamp light. Reveal its relationship to the concept through a partial action (pour, tear, connect, separate). Keep the evidence wall dim behind it.
required_semantics: a real physical action that maps to the concept
forbidden_uses: decorative objects with no semantic mapping
using the same object class for different concepts in the same video

purposes: build a cumulative visual argument across multiple shots
show how pieces of evidence connect to form a conclusion
scene_grammar.composition: Arrange paper cards, photos, or text fragments on the rear evidence plane connected by red string or line. Reveal connections one at a time. The wall grows denser across the video but never obscures the current focus.
required_semantics: a logical connection path between them
forbidden_uses: random cards with no connecting logic
using the evidence wall as a generic background texture
repeating the full wall reveal more than once per video

purposes: show a process of elimination or refinement
scene_grammar.composition: Start with a written statement or diagram. Cross out, underline, or red-line one part. The corrected version slides in or writes itself beside the original. Hold the result state for reading.
forbidden_uses: crossing out without showing what replaces it
using red marks as pure decoration

entries.semantic_trigger: A new piece of evidence or written point enters the argument.
entries.action: A paper card drifts gently into frame from off-screen, settling into its evidence-wall position.
entries.result_state: The card is readable and connected to at least one other element by string or spatial proximity.
entries.hold_policy: Hold the readable result state for the remaining SRT window without extending it.

entries.semantic_trigger: The narration establishes a connection between two pieces of evidence.
entries.action: A red string or line draws itself between two evidence cards, anchoring at both ends.
entries.result_state: Both cards and the connecting line are fully visible and the relationship is legible.
entries.hold_policy: Let the line settle; do not animate further during the same shot.

entries.semantic_trigger: The narration emphasizes a critical detail or conclusion.
entries.action: A slow, subtle camera push toward the primary object or written phrase.
entries.result_state: The subject fills more of the frame; surrounding elements naturally recede.
entries.hold_policy: Stop the push before the hold phase begins; never push through the reading window.

entries.semantic_trigger: The narration makes a sharp turn, reveal, or contradiction.
entries.action: A brief green-tinted flash (2-4 frames) bridges a hard cut to the next composition.
entries.result_state: The new shot is fully established; the flash is gone.
entries.hold_policy: No hold on the transition itself; the result shot owns the remaining time.

transitions.semantic_trigger: Any natural semantic boundary between shots.
transitions.action: Immediate cut to the next composition with no transition effect.
transitions.result_state: The next shot is instantly readable.
transitions.hold_policy: No transition hold; the next shot begins immediately.

continuous_motion.semantic_trigger: Ambient space maintenance during longer explanation segments.
continuous_motion.action: A subtle liquid light shimmer or gentle waver across a paper or liquid surface.
continuous_motion.result_state: The surface remains active but never distracts from the primary text or object.
continuous_motion.hold_policy: Continuous ambient motion; must be seek-safe and not rely on infinite loops.

global_rules: All motion derives from deterministic local time on the composition timeline.
Simplify choreography when the fixed SRT window cannot contain the full action.
Green flash cuts are limited to two per video to avoid overuse.
Slow pushes must stop before the reading phase; never push through text.

modes.usage: Primary presentation with the full studio and evidence-wall environment as an opaque background.
constraints: Do not add burned-in subtitles or BGM.
The near-black green canvas must be an opaque full-frame background.
verification_requirements: Rendered frame inspection at shot midpoints and boundaries

modes.usage: Only individual paper cards, written phrases, or object cutouts may be isolated as overlays. The full studio environment cannot be an overlay.
constraints: Isolate only opaque semantic objects and crisp labels.
Move any soft glow or lamp wash to a separate black-background light layer.
verification_requirements: Alpha edge inspection on card and text boundaries

modes.usage: Green glow and warm lamp light effects have not been validated as standalone light layers.
constraints: Do not relabel an opaque full-frame render as a light layer.
A future version must add blend-mode and black-level evidence before enabling.

hard_rules: Choose the scene from the sentence meaning before selecting a physical object.
One hero object per shot; all other elements form a supporting hierarchy.
The evidence wall grows across the video but each shot has exactly one active focal point.
Screen text is a distilled visual anchor, never a mechanical copy of SRT or narration.
do: Use real everyday objects whose physical properties map to the concept.
Make the result state readable without subtitles in a silent viewing test.
Vary object classes across shots to avoid repetitive kitchen or desk metaphors.
dont: Use a glowing AI orb, code rain, or gear spin as a placeholder for abstract thought.
Let warm lamp light bleed onto the evidence wall and flatten the spatial depth.
Repeat the same physical object class for different concepts in the same video.
Use the evidence wall as a static background texture without active connections.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Adjust the evidence accent glow to match content density without overpowering the warm lamp zone.
constraints: Never exceed 0.7 to avoid washing out paper textures.
Reduce when the shot already has a high-contrast physical object.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Control the proportion of frame occupied by warm lamp illumination versus cool evidence wall.
constraints: Never let warm light exceed 55% of frame area.
Increase for human-story content, decrease for technical methodology.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Move between photo-real object treatment and simplified diagrammatic representation based on content abstraction level.
constraints: Do not mix realism levels within the same shot.
Diagrammatic mode must still show a recognizable physical object, not an abstract icon.

adaptation_knobs.adaptation_goal: Control how many evidence cards or paper elements appear on the evidence wall simultaneously.
constraints: Never exceed 6 cards to maintain legibility.
Reduce to 1-2 for quote-heavy or high-emotion segments.

inspiration_atoms.adaptation: Borrow the warm paper tone, light type contrast, and offset editorial composition from Claude, Cursor, Replicate, and Wired. Derive video sizes and hold timing independently from webpage whitespace.
When real object photography is available, let it occupy 60-100% of frame with UI elements receding to footnotes. Apply the Runway and Apple principle of photography-first, interface-second.

Use hand-drawn lines, stickers, or marginal notes as secondary explanation devices following the PostHog and Sentry pattern. Keep them subordinate to the primary evidence and never substitute for core argument.

signature_motifs.description: A rear-plane evidence wall with paper cards connected by red string, serving as the cumulative visual argument backbone across the entire video.
signature_combination: paper cards on rear evidence plane

signature_motifs.description: Everyday physical objects (cup, empty pot, seasoning, ingredients) used as concrete carriers for abstract methodology steps.

exhausted_motifs.reason: A glowing orb replaces the actual writing or thinking process with an overused generic symbol.
Terminal scrolling does not belong in a physical studio and paper-based editorial world.
A spinning gear is a hollow proxy for system or process; use real physical actions instead.
Background gradient drift and progress bar animations are meaningless rhythm filler in a physical-metaphor system.

conflicts_with.reason: A physical object studio with paper evidence walls and a deep-sea particle HUD world compete for the same background role. Their worldviews are opposite: tangible human-scale editing vs. abstract data-center scale.
conflicts_with.resolution: Borrow at most one data-structure scene pattern from deep-current-hud restyled with paper and lamp materials. Never borrow the deep-water material, particles, or HUD line motion.

borrowable_patterns.description: A portable physical-object-to-abstract-concept translation layout without the greenroom material signature.
conditions: The borrowing template provides its own material and lighting system.
The physical object class must be coherent with the borrowing template's world.

restrictions: Do not distribute source media, private copy, or local paths.
Trademark, font, photo, product UI, and brand copy rights are not included.

forbidden_materials: private source media and business copy
brand logos, proprietary fonts, photos, product interfaces, and claims
original CASE-001 project files and screenshot dependencies

removed_categories: original project shot timings and quotas

stale_rules.original_claim: Ambient motion must be attached to a timeline and bare loops are prohibited.
stale_rules.isolation_reason: The intent of deterministic seek-safe ambient motion is correct, but the specific API constraints must be verified against current HyperFrames core and keyframes skills.

stale_rules.original_claim: Fixed 4K pixel dimensions, font sizes, and safe areas from the original project.
stale_rules.isolation_reason: Pixel values only apply to the original aspect ratio; schema stores relative roles and a reference canvas. Actual dimensions must be derived per target aspect ratio and verified with frame inspection.
